body:
Hi @sniperadmin, seems like they fixed it, it's back already.

If the issue were to arise again, we don't own jsDelivr so there is nothing we could do about it but contact them.

Alternatively you can [install it from npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/instantsearch.css) and bundle it with your app if you don't want to rely on jsDelivr.
